entries.zh: 串成一排、列成一串（西语 retahila＝成串成排之物）；字面汉字为“粿”，或指把粿品串排成串，〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: to string up in a row (retahila); lit. “rice cake/kuè”, possibly referring to threading cakes in a string — uncertain
entries.notes: 西语 retahila（成串成排）与汉字“粿”语义接合需靠推断，“ca.”缩写不明，故降为低置信。

entries.zh: 叠好、堆叠整齐；整理、安置妥当
entries.en: to stack up, pile neatly; to arrange, set in order

entries.zh: 压下（下人的）言语争辩、使其静下来；平息下面的争执聒噪〔字形存疑：遏/过〕
entries.en: to quiet down the talk/discourse of inferiors; to suppress or calm contention below [character uncertain: 遏/過]
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注“遏[疑:遏/过]”，且西语“componer discurso de inferiores”与“遏静”的对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 遏杀、压杀（压制处置下面的人）；弹压杀害〔字形存疑：遏/过〕
entries.en: to suppress and put down (inferiors) by force; to crush or kill [character uncertain: 遏/過]
entries.notes: 同上，汉字有“遏/过”两读存疑，西语与闽南音的对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 结彩：扎结彩绸，装点彩门、彩棚
entries.en: kat-tsài: to festoon with colored silk; to deck out an arch, a decorated stage/platform

entries.zh: 结彩亭：搭扎彩亭、彩牌楼（节庆迎神所用）
entries.en: kat-tsài-têng: to build a festooned arch or decorated pavilion (for festive processions)

entries.zh: 排整齐、排列齐整；按次序整理
entries.en: to arrange in order; to set out in a neat row

entries.zh: 祭文：为亡者撰写的祭奠文辞、悼文
entries.en: chè-bûn: a sacrificial/memorial text; eulogy composed for the dead

entries.zh: 祝文：祝祷亡者事迹之文，祭祝文辞（祝告死者生平的文章）〔西语后半句残损难辨〕
entries.en: tsiok-bûn: an invocation/prayer text reciting the deeds of the deceased [latter half of Spanish gloss garbled]
entries.notes: 西语栏“y dalam lequemar”拼写残乱难解，仅前半“Composicion delos hechos del difunto”可用。

entries.zh: 整起衣裳：把衣服整理穿戴好；收拾衣着
entries.en: tséng-khí ī: to put one's clothes in order, dress up, arrange one's garments

entries.zh: 致（与他们）处得很好、交好和睦〔字形存疑：省/首〕
entries.en: to get along well with them, be on good terms [character uncertain: 省/首]
entries.notes: 汉字第二字有“省/首”两读存疑，四栏对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 制药料：配药、调制药品药材
entries.en: chè-io̍h-liāu: to compound/prepare medicines, mix medicinal ingredients

entries.zh: 相与、相处；调解料理事务、交往做买卖
entries.en: saⁿ-chú: to get along/deal together; to settle or manage any business or transaction

entries.zh: 说合：居中说合成事，撮合交易、说定合意〔西语尾缀 Secaucngan 为混写，未全解〕
entries.en: siāⁿ-ha̍p: to mediate and bring parties to agreement, broker a deal [trailing Spanish “Secaucngan” is mixed-script and only partly resolved]
entries.notes: 西语“haçer ŷ Secaucngan”含闽南语混写缩语，全义依赖“说合”汉字与音栏推断。

entries.zh: 叠起：把东西一件叠放在另一件上，摞起来
entries.en: tia̍p-khí: to stack one thing upon another, pile up

entries.zh: 时文：依时令节候所作之文；时下流行的文章体裁
entries.en: sî-bûn: a composition on timely topics; the current fashion of prose composition

entries.zh: 面貌：外表容颜、脸面相貌
entries.en: bīn-māu: countenance, facial appearance, outward look

entries.zh: 容貌：仪容相貌、外表模样
